arrays.unit_ids: Unicode decimal source IDs; eligible U; arbitrary coherent axis order
arrays.occupancy_seconds: finite real[20], canonical zero bins exactly0, remaining positive source-close
arrays.shift_offsets_seconds: finite real[U,300], source RNG-close after matching unit/draw IDs

npz.extra_arrays: Bounded safe non-object finite numeric/string arrays allowed; never scientific authority.
npz.storage: No pickle/object/structured types; real i/u/f, bool or Unicode/bytes axes; maximum3dimensions; no nonfinite numeric placeholders.

csv.row_order: arbitrary exact eligible identity coverage, no duplicates
csv.extra_columns: Bounded descriptive extras allowed; no alternative authority

results.authority: Means of accepted CSV rows using math.fsum; n_units0 all meansnull; any row undefined =>null andadjusted meansnull.

source_observed.reference_frame: literal UTF-8 scalar from original Position/reference_frame

metadata.all_units: All110 records unit_id(str)/source_row(int zero-based original row)/cell_area(str)/cell_type(str)/stored_spike_count(int)/window_spike_count(int)/observed_spike_count(int)/eligible(bool)/reason(str); exact source-defined values, arbitrary record order by explicit unit_id; bounded extras are descriptive, not alternative authority.

findings: Nonempty bounded UTF-8 text; interpretation judged through explicit public scope and numerical outputs, not hidden keyword or required-outcome trigger.
failure: Any failure_report.json lexists is authoritative failure. Oracle writes failed_precondition marker and nonzero status; partial/resource_pilot artifacts never production.
benign_variation: Coherent unit/bin/draw permutations, record/key order, safe real storage satisfying precision, harmless metadata/prose/version extras accepted; no blanket six-decimal guarantee for offsets/occupancy.
